Both functions return torch::Tensor. Use c10::cuda::getCurrentCUDAStream().stream() to get current stream.
Register both functions with pybind using py::arg as per contract fragments, including momentum default 0.1.
No CUDA kernels or torch:: operators in binding; only launcher calls.
